name: controller-reads-registry-credentials
reason: C-0015: the controller resolves OCI registry credentials from Secrets referenced in Repository and Resource objects, so its ClusterRole needs get/list/watch on Secrets (no create, update or delete).

name: controller-leader-election-configmaps
reason: C-0037: controller-runtime leader election writes a ConfigMap in the release namespace; the Role is namespace-scoped.

name: controller-needs-api-access
reason: C-0034, C-0053: the controller authenticates to the Kubernetes API with its projected service account token, so the token must be mounted.

name: network-policy-opt-in
reason: C-0030: the chart's NetworkPolicy is opt-in (manager.networkPolicy.enabled) because it needs a CNI that enforces it. The scan of the chart with the policy enabled has no exception for C-0030.
